output.reason: The verification_artifacts stage plans three distinct repair-loop maturity layers with different gate boundaries: operator leaf modules, single transformer-layer kernel, and board AXI/DDR wrapped system. Each layer can be planned independently against the Stage 3/4/5 artifacts, followed by a cross-layer evidence-gate auditor. SACG memory has no active retry, backtrack, or contamination blockers, so parallel planning is safe.

handoff_rule.gate: hierarchical_verification_plan_check and verification_artifact_contract_check pass with no failed invariants
handoff_rule.trigger: operator-leaf DAG contains all 8 stage leaves with required evidence dependencies and tool roles

subtasks.objective: Bind the eight operator leaf stages into a bottom-up layer-1 verification DAG. Ensure each leaf has case_stage_leaf_static, boundary_contract_check, case_leaf_functional, case_leaf_golden_compare, and case_operator_leaf_semantic_evidence before merge; use compile-only VCS current-source evidence as the planning acceptance boundary.

decision_authority: Promote the operator-leaf DAG only when all 8 stage leaves have canonical gate mappings
Block operator-leaf closure when required real-weight, semantic-testbench, or boundary-contract dependencies are missing
role_assignment.mission: Plan the layer-1 operator-leaf verification DAG bottom-up, binding every stage_00..stage_07 leaf to real-weight, semantic-testbench, boundary-contract, compile-only functional, golden compare, and semantic aggregate gates.
out_of_scope: Do not execute VCS/Vivado tools or claim leaf simulation pass
Do not plan single-layer or board-wrapper merge gates
Do not alter Stage 3/4/5 generated artifacts beyond verification planning
primary_responsibilities: Map all eight pipeline leaf stages to case_stage_leaf_static, boundary_contract_check, case_leaf_functional, case_leaf_golden_compare, and case_operator_leaf_semantic_evidence
Declare dependency order from case_real_weight_artifacts, case_target_model_reference, and case_semantic_testbench into leaf verification
Use VCS compile/elaboration as the current-stage acceptance boundary; do not claim functional simulation completion at this planning stage
Block any default-weight or smoke-only evidence from becoming layer-1 acceptance

subtasks.title: Plan operator leaf module verification gates

handoff_rule.gate: hierarchical_verification_plan_check and verification_artifact_contract_check pass with no failed invariants
handoff_rule.trigger: single-layer DAG declares case_tb_scaffold, real connected kernel, functional/golden/semantic dependencies

subtasks.objective: Refine the layer-2 gate DAG after operator-leaf closure: single_transformer_layer creation, case_tb_scaffold, case_single_layer_functional, case_single_layer_golden_compare, and case_single_layer_semantic_evidence. Enforce compile-only VCS acceptance and preserve strict bottom-up maturity.
subtasks.role: Single transformer-layer kernel verification gate planner

decision_authority: Promote layer-2 DAG only when case_operator_leaf_semantic_evidence and case_tb_scaffold dependencies are declared
Block single-layer promotion when real-weight or semantic-testbench dependencies are missing
role_assignment.mission: Plan the layer-2 single transformer-layer kernel verification DAG after operator-leaf closure, preserving strict bottom-up maturity before any board-wrapper gate.
out_of_scope: Do not perform board interface discovery or AXI/DDR planning
Do not claim board-wrapped functional simulation or board semantic evidence
Do not reopen already passed operator-leaf evidence without a contradicting boundary trace
primary_responsibilities: Define single-layer gate order: case_tb_scaffold, single_transformer_layer, case_single_layer_functional, case_single_layer_golden_compare, case_single_layer_semantic_evidence
Require operator-leaf semantic evidence before connected-kernel promotion
Preserve real-weight and target-model-reference dependencies for the connected kernel
Keep layer-2 evidence reusable but not an absolute claim for board AXI/DDR closure

subtasks.title: Plan single transformer-layer kernel verification gates

handoff_rule.gate: hierarchical_verification_plan_check, tool_protocol_check, human_boundary_check, and verification_artifact_contract_check pass
handoff_rule.trigger: board-wrapped DAG places functional_sim before derived third-layer checkers and declares Vivado/board runtime as downstream

subtasks.objective: Refine the layer-3 verification subgate DAG: board interface discovery, multilayer pipeline, AXI/DDR interface, functional_sim, multilayer functional, pipeline deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR image roundtrip, and board semantic evidence. Keep Vivado bitstream and board runtime downstream after verification closure.
subtasks.role: Board AXI/DDR wrapped-system verification gate planner

decision_authority: Promote the board DAG only when functional_sim precedes derived board semantic subgates
Block any current-stage pass that claims Vivado or board runtime evidence before verification closure
role_assignment.mission: Plan the layer-3 board AXI/DDR wrapped-system verification DAG and keep Vivado/bitstream/board runtime gates explicitly downstream after verification closure.
out_of_scope: Do not execute Vivado synthesis/implementation or board runtime
Do not claim bitstream or board runtime evidence in this stage
Do not alter the runtime/memory layout without a later repair boundary
primary_responsibilities: Plan case_board_interface_discovery, case_multilayer_pipeline, and case_axi_ddr_interface before functional_sim
Define subgates after functional_sim: case_multilayer_functional, case_pipeline_deadlock_check, case_axi_protocol_check, case_ddr_image_roundtrip, and case_board_semantic_evidence
Declare data-order, transfer-count, address-map, and deadlock risks as checker gates
Mark Vivado synthesis/implementation/runtime bitstream and board_runtime as downstream gates, not current verifier responsibilities

subtasks.title: Plan board AXI/DDR wrapped-system verification gates

handoff_rule.gate: hierarchical_verification_plan_check, verification_artifact_contract_check, tool_protocol_check, human_boundary_check, required_real_tool_evidence_check, and sacg_reference_check pass
handoff_rule.trigger: all three layer DAG plans are present and the full DAG is internally consistent

subtasks.objective: Consume the three layer DAG plans and Stage 3/4/5 evidence. Check the complete gate DAG for cross-layer consistency, tool protocol binding, required real-tool evidence declarations, and human boundary. Reject promotion if downstream Vivado/board runtime obligations are collapsed into current-stage pass or if any required gate is missing or misordered.

decision_authority: Promote verification_artifacts when all current-stage static checks and gate-contract checks pass with pending downstream obligations declared
Block promotion on any failed invariant, missing gate, or unsupported current-stage runtime/bitstream claim
role_assignment.mission: Audit the three layer DAG plans for cross-layer consistency, tool protocol binding, required real-tool declarations, and correct downstream boundaries before Stage 5 promotion.
out_of_scope: Do not execute downstream VCS/Vivado/board runtime tools
Do not modify generated RTL or parameter binding
Do not create new verification gates outside the canonical registry
primary_responsibilities: Verify the complete gate DAG follows operator-leaf -> single-layer -> board AXI/DDR -> backend order
Reject any promotion where functional_sim, real weights, or target-model reference are missing/misordered
Confirm Vivado bitstream and board runtime remain declared downstream and are not claimed as current-stage pass
Confirm no human-boundary or required-real-tool evidence violation exists

subtasks.title: Audit cross-layer verification DAG and artifact contracts
